[IALC.6.2] Build mode per artifact:

| Artifact | mode |
|---|---|
| from-source build (default) | `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` — link-time-overridable; `DS_ALLOC_MODE=1` opts out to libc, `-DDS_ALLOC_HEADER` inlines an integrator allocator in macro mode |
| released prebuilt `libds.a` | `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` |
| pyds extension | the default `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` (honour [IALC.5.3]), or the chosen mode |
